Piano di stivaggio

A detailed plan showing the placement of cargo on board a vessel to ensure safe, efficient, and balanced loading.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Piano di stivaggio?

In this glossary, Piano di stivaggio refers to: A detailed plan showing the placement of cargo on board a vessel to ensure safe, efficient, and balanced loading.

How is Piano di stivaggio used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Il primo ufficiale ha preparato il piano di stivaggio per massimizzare la stabilità della nave e rispettare le normative IMO."

Why does Piano di stivaggio matter in logistics?

Piano di stivaggio matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Piano di stivaggio?

Piano di stivaggio is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

Where does this definition come from?
